outputCreases.policy: Binary output geometric dihedral threshold; engineering export policy
outputCreases.nativeSlotEncodingScope: Low bit of each two-bit face-edge slot, measured by998; no high-bit/partial-strength/decay semantics

planarPolicy.projection: Nearest original source triangle per input sample; adjacent facet crossings unfolded onto their shared edge
planarPolicy.quadrangulation: Convex adjacent-triangle pairing with guide-tangent score and length-three augmentations, then globally conforming edge-midpoint/cell-center subdivision

limitations: Engineering alternative, not native field/parameterization/extraction equivalence.
Target count is approximate and constrained by physical seams/guide sampling.
Arbitrary source attributes/partial crease strengths are not transferred.
Sparse curve steps across nonadjacent facets need additional surface samples.
Sampled surface/feature errors are not a Hausdorff certificate.
Topology and vertex links do not alone certify absence of all 3D self-intersections.
Binary geometric crease preservation does not imply arbitrary source attribute transfer.

selectedApiGuard: Selected filesystem/native-process APIs denied during actual planar construction
